description: This PHP source file generates a web-based status page for network connection details of a device, including WAN IP configuration, modem status, DHCP parameters, error codes, and modem statistics. It incorporates server-side PHP logic with embedded HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to present dynamic network information typically used for diagnostics or user interface in a router or gateway device.
